entities.name: 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE
entities.description: A substate chosen in the UE when it is known that a selected cell for 3GPP access or TA for non-3GPP access is unable to provide normal service due to various forbidden conditions or CAG restrictions.

entities.name: Forbidden PLMN or SNPN
entities.description: Condition where the selected cell over 3GPP access is in a forbidden PLMN or SNPN.

entities.name: Forbidden tracking area
entities.description: Condition where the selected cell over 3GPP access is in a forbidden tracking area or TA for non-3GPP access is forbidden.

entities.name: CAG ID not in Allowed CAG list
entities.description: Condition where the selected cell is a CAG cell whose CAG ID is not included in the Allowed CAG list in the CAG information list for the PLMN.

entities.name: Non-CAG cell in PLMN with CAG-only indication
entities.description: Condition where the selected cell is a non-CAG cell in a PLMN for which there exists an indication that the UE is only allowed to access 5GS via CAG cells in the CAG information list for the PLMN.

entities.name: Limited service provided
entities.description: Property indicating that the UE is in a state where normal service is not available, and only limited service is possible.

relations.description: Condition where the selected cell is in a forbidden PLMN or SNPN establishes the 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE state.
Condition where the selected cell is in a forbidden tracking area or TA for non-3GPP access is forbidden establishes the 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE state.
Condition where the CAG ID is not in the Allowed CAG list establishes the 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE state.
Condition where a non-CAG cell is selected in a PLMN with CAG-only indication establishes the 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE state.
The 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE state establishes the property that only limited service is provided.
